sources.title: Zuo et al. — The influence of target layout and target graphic type on searching performance based on eye-tracking technology
sources.finding: 39 students,24-inch desktop,100×100px automobile-console icons; location affected some search measures and interacted with icon style. Circular-vs-rectangular comparison was indirect.
sources.inference: Test relocation using each retained G1 glyph/lineage; changing the anchor zone can alter visual search, and location results need not generalize across glyph styles.
sources.limits: Not wrist or launch-map; unlimited search, circular block always first, young sample; do not infer top-left or any single corner is universally best.

sources.title: Xia et al. — Visualizing on the Wrist: Impact of Motion, Dial Shape and Visualization Type on Smartwatch
sections: Authors repository README, study design summary
sources.finding: Official abstract reports N32 comparing bar/radial, round/square and sitting/walking; walking reduced estimation accuracy in their task.
sources.inference: Treat real wrist motion and dial shape as separate external-validity conditions; a static390px clearance gate does not establish glanceability.
sources.limits: Full paper not obtained; no marker-search effect, direction or pixel threshold inferred. Appendix/code were not executed and no third-party summary is used as evidence.

sources.title: Android Developers — Handle different watch shapes
sources.date: Current official documentation; page date not established
sources.finding: A rectangular layout can crop corner content on a round single-screen UI; BoxInsetLayout defines an interior region for child content.
sources.inference: Compute a safe region for full glyph support, then position geography so the real launch coordinate projects into that region.
sources.limits: Wear OS library behavior, not Garmin-specific padding or a demonstrated minimum margin. Do not copy15dp from sample into390px as a norm.

sources.title: Esri ArcGIS Pro — Symbol units and size
sources.date: ArcGIS Pro3.3 documentation; publication date unspecified
sections: Consistent display size vs measurable map size
sources.finding: Locator symbols may keep a consistent display size independently of changing map scale. Reference-scale symbols instead grow/shrink with the view.
sources.inference: Hold the exact retained G1 marker footprint fixed while varying geographic scale/radius and camera placement in G2.
sources.limits: Rendering semantics, not a user study. Fixed display size does not itself ensure useful context, correct position, sufficient clearance or noticeability.

sources.title: Ordnance Survey — Generalisation
sources.finding: Reduced map scale requires selective detail; simplify nonessential features while preserving defining characteristics and spatial relationships. Displacement is a distinct operation.
sources.inference: Simplify graticule/minor texture and nonessential geography when reserving marker space; keep coastline/country context and truthful launch anchor.
sources.limits: General cartographic practice, not wrist experiment. The fact that some maps displace features does not authorize silently moving SpaceFox launch coordinates.

sources.title: Mapbox GL JS — Offset the vanishing point using padding
sources.date: Current official example; page date unspecified
sources.finding: Example retains geographic marker coordinates while changing camera padding to account for floating sidebars.
sources.inference: Reserve visual space occupied by clock/mission/fields through camera or geo-window layout; change projection/camera instead of clamping the marker.
sources.limits: Pitched Mapbox example, not Garmin or proof for spherical projection. Example/runtime not executed; requires an API token and no paid API was used.

source_findings_vs_inference: Separate fields per source; none is an experiment on SpaceFox.

geometry.meaning: Illustrative calculation only; not full glyph clearance, not proof of failure cause, and not a candidate verdict. Actual pixel center convention may differ.
geometry.support_rule: Let F=(screenCircle intersect geoWindow) minus occupied UI. Full glyph offsets G fit at anchor p iff p+G is a subset of F, equivalently p belongs to F eroded byG.
geometry.projection_rule: Pan/recenter/rescale geographic rendering and recompute the real point; never clamp or hand-displace marker while claiming unchanged geographic coordinates.
geometry.size_rule: Retained G1 rendered glyph size/style must remain fixed unless explicitly a new size treatment; geography scale is independent.

hypotheses.variable: camera/geo-window placement, retained G1 glyph unchanged
hypotheses.prediction: A reserved free region for complete marker support can remove edge/UI collisions while maintaining true coordinate projection.
hypotheses.test: For each supplied G1 lineage and each of20context mutations, evaluate complete final support mask after all masks/layers, not anchor alone; subtract clock/mission/field opaque regions.
hypotheses.criterion: Zero clipped essential glyph/outline pixels, zero overlap with occupied UI, coordinate anchor agrees with same projection formula; optional2px clearance is a proposed margin, not source norm.

hypotheses.variable: geography scale with fixed accepted G1 marker and controlled anchor region
hypotheses.prediction: Reduced/reframed geography with sufficient coast/country context makes launchpoint easier to locate than the same lineage original context.
hypotheses.test: Uncued1s marker localization, separate2s country/site reading, matched render/physical scale; compare within lineage.
hypotheses.criterion: Detection improves≥5percentage points; HH:MM and full country/site reading lose≤3points; engineering tests above pass. No claim of achieving these values without people.

hypotheses.variable: nonessential map texture, geographic projection/anchor/glyph fixed
hypotheses.prediction: Lowering or eliminating competing minor texture near the target reduces search errors while retaining geographic meaning.
hypotheses.test: Compare retained coastline/land/country context with and without optional graticule/minor texture/decor; full required labels identical.
hypotheses.criterion: Marker errors reduce≥20%relative to baseline with time/field reading loss≤3percentage points; geographic correctness unchanged. This is an untested project criterion.
